thesis_summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers has a strong potential for growth in the eco-friendly shipping market.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to secure a significant commercial order within the next 12 months
ten_k_highlights: The company has a strong management team with experience in the shipping industry.
The company plans to expand its tanker fleet to 10 vessels within the next 5 years.
The company has a strong focus on eco-friendly operations and has implemented advanced technology to reduce emissions.
valuation_note: FCF yield -1.1%, PEG 0.1, EV/EBITDA 64, P/S 22 — very richly valued — starter position only.
